title: Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting with Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify. One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.

translated_title: 基于扩散语言模型的多目标少样本提示
translated_abstract: 当指令和奖励难以明确指定时，少样本提示非常有用。其中一个典型应用是通过示例进行编辑，即需要将演示的格式更改或API迁移应用到多个位置。然而，此类编辑通常同时依赖于左右两侧的上下文，这使得使用因果自回归模型进行生成变得困难。因此，我们提出了基于扩散语言模型的多目标少样本提示方法，其中示例指导在共享画布内对多个掩码区域进行填充。为了解决少样本提示中难以可靠遵循示例这一已知挑战，我们进一步利用画布的选择性掩码来推导似然比奖励，该奖励倾向于选择得到示例支持的填充结果。在少样本提示基准测试和软件重构案例研究中，我们发现示例演示提高了填充准确性，且示例引导在若干设置中带来了进一步提升。
tldr: 该论文提出基于扩散语言模型的多目标少样本提示方法，通过共享画布中多个掩码区域的示例引导填充，并结合选择性掩码推导的似然比奖励，可靠地遵循示例完成跨多个位置的编辑任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, guiding the infilling of multiple masked regions on a shared canvas with examples, and leveraging a likelihood-ratio reward derived from selective masking to reliably follow demonstrations across multiple edit sites.
